Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), indeterminate Camp Gate issue of 324-330, possibly Providentiae Caess given leftward bust, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust draped and cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: [---]NSTANTI[--]. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers, door, star above. Reverse inscription: possibly PROVIDEN [TIAE CAESS]. Diameter:…
